node.title: Re^3: print() on closed filehandle WRITE_FH
node.author: pryrt
node.doctext: You have to do the <c>my $orig_fh = select(WRITE_FH);</c> the first time you <c>select WRITE_FH</c> -- otherwise, you've already lost the original file handle. Then, just before or just after the <c>close WRITE_FH</c>, you need to select the original again using <c>select($orig_fh)</c>, so that it's active after you've closed WRITE_FH.
